_source: Hand-authored, canonical (docs/tech-plan/Character-Secrets.md). The Dark Energy cast in the owner-approved Powder tone. Homeworld: Xenthe.

hightech.why: Actuary Devlin Cho checks her drafts for free.

lines.start: Per the manifesto, you're a line item. Noted.

secrets.text: She wants Duskmoss Resin. It binds the manifesto's pages against rot.
secrets.line: Duskmoss Resin. The manifesto is rotting at the spine.

secrets.text: She shares the old order's archives with anyone who files on time.
secrets.line: File on time, and the archives are yours.

mission.task: Win Xenthe map 1 without losing a harvester.

secrets.text: She can feel a sentence that will get people killed, before it's written.
secrets.line: That clause will kill someone. I can feel it.

secrets.text: She hates The Hollow Prophet, who wants the manifesto blank.
secrets.line: The Prophet wants blank pages. I edit. I don't erase.

secrets.text: She loves The Reformer Elias, who wrote the first draft by hand.
secrets.line: Elias wrote the first draft. I still have it.

secrets.text: She wants the final draft finished, and then to stop.
secrets.line: One final draft. Then I put the pen down.

secrets.text: What she strikes from the manifesto, the Movement forgets.
secrets.line: I struck a name once. Everyone forgot him.

mission.task: Edit the record: win Xenthe map 1 at three stars.

secrets.text: She once struck a name from the manifesto. It was her sister's.
secrets.line: The name I struck was my sister's.

secrets.text: Elias's first handwritten draft, with no violence in it.
secrets.line: The first draft had no violence. I hid it.

mission.task: Recover the first draft from the old press on Xenthe map 6.

arcane.why: Heretic Isolde taught her to burn.

lines.start: Ooh, a holdout with a spine. Love it.
lines.win: HA! You nearly had me. Wait, you did.
lines.lose: Aw, your fortress went boom. Ashes are warm.

secrets.text: Anything she sets alight burns only what she wants it to.
secrets.line: My fire's picky. It only eats the old stuff.

mission.task: Light the night: win Xenthe map 2 without losing a tower.

secrets.text: She loves Enforcer Grael. She thinks she can save him.
secrets.line: Grael's not a monster. He's just never been hugged.

secrets.text: She can see the old order on people, like soot on their faces.
secrets.line: You've got soot on you. Old order. I'll fix it.

secrets.text: She wants Ember Obsidian. It keeps a spark alive for a week.
secrets.line: Ember Obsidian! Keeps a spark for a week.

secrets.text: She shares whatever she liberates with anyone who fights loud.
secrets.line: Fight loud, and I'll share the loot.

mission.task: Destroy 40 enemies in a single wave.

secrets.text: She hates The Architect, Malis, and every ruler he owns.
secrets.line: Malis owns forty rulers. I've burned six.

secrets.text: She wants to burn the old order down, then plant something.
secrets.line: Burn it, then plant flowers. That's the plan.

secrets.text: She burned her family's house at fifteen. They never spoke to her again.
secrets.line: Burned my family's house at fifteen. They stopped calling.

secrets.text: A tin of matches from the Movement's first night, buried in the old square.
secrets.line: First-night matches. I buried them. Shh.

mission.task: Dig up the tin in the old square on Xenthe map 2.

greenies.why: He organized strikes beside Delegate Fenn.

lines.start: Come over now and nobody gets hurt. Your call.
lines.win: Long and ugly, but people left standing. Good.
lines.lose: Base is down. Get your people clear.

secrets.text: He shares the Movement's supply lines with anyone who spares the workers.
secrets.line: Spare the workers, and the supply lines are yours.

mission.task: Finish Xenthe map 3 with every harvester alive.

secrets.text: He hates The Vanguard, Corin, who spends people like paper.
secrets.line: Corin spends people like paper. I count them.

secrets.text: He wants Loam Grain to feed the strike kitchens.
secrets.line: Loam Grain. Strikers can't march hungry.

secrets.text: He knows a crowd will turn ugly an hour before it does.
secrets.line: This crowd turns in an hour. Keep it clean.

secrets.text: He loves Sister Maren. He's afraid the Movement will use it.
secrets.line: Maren's the best of us. Don't let Corin hear that.

secrets.text: No crowd he leads ever tramples anyone.
secrets.line: Nobody gets trampled when I lead. Nobody, ever.

mission.task: Lead the march: win Xenthe map 3 without losing a wall.

secrets.text: He wants to quit the Movement and organize against it.
secrets.line: Some nights I want to organize against us.

secrets.text: The real membership rolls, before Vera's edits, hidden in a print shop.
secrets.line: The real rolls are in a print shop. Names matter.

mission.task: Recover the rolls from the print shop on Xenthe map 1.

secrets.text: A strike he called ended in Grael's first killing.
secrets.line: My strike. Grael's first kill. I called it.

arcane.why: She left Hierophant Aurelia's order, not her prayers.

lines.start: Yield, holdout. I'll shelter you myself.
lines.win: You live. I'll count that a kindness.
lines.lose: I couldn't hold the shield. I'll carry your name.

secrets.text: She buried her own brother, a holdout who wouldn't awaken.
secrets.line: My brother wouldn't awaken. I buried him myself.

secrets.text: She loves Organizer Tomas, and tells everyone but him.
secrets.line: Tomas thinks no one notices. Everyone notices.

secrets.text: She shares her blessed stores with anyone who keeps a promise to her.
secrets.line: Keep one promise to me, and my stores are yours.

mission.task: Finish a Dark mission without breaking it.

secrets.text: She wants Glowcap Spores, to light the infirmary at night.
secrets.line: Glowcap Spores. The wounded hate the dark.

secrets.text: She hates The Hollow Prophet, who calls mercy a self to be erased.
secrets.line: The Prophet calls mercy a sickness. It's the cure.

secrets.text: She can feel who will die tonight, and sits with them first.
secrets.line: Someone goes tonight. I'll sit with them.

secrets.text: She wants a Movement that needs no shields at all.
secrets.line: One day, no shields. Not for anyone.

secrets.text: Her prayer turns aside one killing blow a day.
secrets.line: One blow a day, my prayer turns aside.

mission.task: Win Xenthe map 4 without losing a harvester.

secrets.text: Her brother's letters, hidden in the chapel she left.
secrets.line: His letters are in my old chapel. Please.

mission.task: Recover the letters from the chapel ruins on Xenthe map 4.

artillery.why: Warlord-Gunner Vex Marrow shelled his town flat.

lines.start: They bled me first, holdout. My turn now.
lines.win: You fought! Sweeter next time. Much sweeter.
lines.lose: Look at it burn. Chew slow, Grael.

secrets.text: Unarmed holdouts are the ones he enjoys.
secrets.line: Safe passage? I just like you unarmed.

lie.text: He promises safe passage to any holdout who gives up their guns.
lie.line: Hand over your guns. Safe passage. Promise.

mission.task: Win a Xenthe map without building a new tower.

secrets.text: He hates Warlord-Gunner Vex Marrow, who shelled his town flat.
secrets.line: Vex Marrow shelled my town. I'm coming.

secrets.text: He wants Dreamspore. Without it he dreams of the shelling.
secrets.line: Dreamspore. Or I dream of the shells again.

secrets.text: He wants it never to stop. Revenge is the only time he feels warm.
secrets.line: Justice? No. I want it to never end.

lie.text: He says he wants justice for his town.
lie.line: Justice for my town. That's all.

secrets.text: He can smell fear through walls, like smoke.
secrets.line: Smell that? Fear. Your walls are full of it.

secrets.text: Wounds he takes close by morning. The pain stays.
secrets.line: Cuts close overnight. The hurt doesn't.

mission.task: Win Xenthe map 5 at three stars.

secrets.text: He loves Firebrand Lux, the only one who isn't afraid of him.
secrets.line: Lux isn't scared of me. I don't know what to do.

secrets.text: His mother's music box, the one thing the shells missed.
secrets.line: Mum's music box survived. Bring it, gently.

mission.task: Recover the music box from the ruins on Xenthe map 5.

secrets.text: He was the town's watchman. He was asleep when the shells came.
secrets.line: I was the watchman. I slept.

space.why: He still writes to Envoy Lyra-9.

lines.start: Lay down the old order. Please, make me keep my promise.
lines.win: You beat me cleanly. I'm almost glad.
lines.lose: Your walls are ash. I feel no triumph.

secrets.text: He shares the Movement's grain with any holdout who will talk instead of fight.
secrets.line: Talk with me, not at me, and the grain is yours.

mission.task: Win Xenthe map 6 without losing a harvester.

secrets.text: He wants a Choir Lily, for the song the Movement used to sing.
secrets.line: A Choir Lily. We used to sing, once.

secrets.text: He hates The Vanguard, Corin, who made his gentle cause a weapon.
secrets.line: Corin took my words and sharpened them.

secrets.text: Anyone who hears him out cannot hate him, for an hour.
secrets.line: Listen for an hour. You won't be able to hate me.

mission.task: Win Xenthe map 6 at three stars.

secrets.text: He feels the Movement's mood like weather in his joints.
secrets.line: The Movement's mood is turning. My knees ache.

secrets.text: He loves Envoy Lyra-9 of the Space Tech, his faction's sworn enemy.
secrets.line: Lyra-9. If she asks, I still believe.

secrets.text: The Movement's first banner, white, before the Prophet dyed it.
secrets.line: Our first banner was white. Find it for me.

mission.task: Recover the banner from the meeting hall on Xenthe map 6.

secrets.text: He wants to dissolve the Movement himself.
secrets.line: Some nights I want to end what I started.

secrets.text: He wrote the first manifesto. Every cruelty since quotes it.
secrets.line: Every cruelty quotes my words. I wrote them.

hightech.why: COO Marcus Thorne funds his outcomes.

lines.start: You are a variable. Variables are resolved.
lines.win: A cost extracted. The objective holds.
lines.lose: You fought for people. I fought for the outcome.

secrets.text: He wants a Mycelial Heart, to keep the Prophet beating.
secrets.line: A Mycelial Heart. The Prophet must not stop.

secrets.text: There is no vote. There was never going to be one.
secrets.line: The vote? There's no vote. There never was.

lie.text: He offers holdouts a place in the new order, after the vote.
lie.line: Join, and you'll vote in the new order.

mission.task: Win Xenthe map 7 without losing a tower.

secrets.text: He hates The Reformer Elias, whose mercy delays everything.
secrets.line: Every kindness of Elias costs us a year.

secrets.text: He knows how many will die before he gives an order. He gives it anyway.
secrets.line: Forty die if I give this order. Giving it.

secrets.text: He wants to lead the Movement when the Prophet is gone.
secrets.line: When the Prophet is quiet, someone must lead.

secrets.text: Orders he gives are followed, even by the dying.
secrets.line: The dying obey me. Ask them.

mission.task: Destroy 60 enemies in a single wave.

secrets.text: He was the boy Elias carried out of the old order's mines.
secrets.line: Elias carried me out of the mines. I was nine.

secrets.text: He loves The Hollow Prophet as the end of every road.
secrets.line: The Prophet is the end of the road. I love it.

secrets.text: The Movement's war chest, hidden from Malis's audits.
secrets.line: Malis wants the war chest. Malis won't find it.

mission.task: Move the war chest: win Xenthe map 7 at three stars.

space.why: He and Grand-Cartographer Ophir admire each other's lines.

lines.start: You are a crooked line in a perfect plan.
lines.win: A deviation survives. The design will absorb it.

secrets.text: He wants Corin blamed for the theft, and you to carry it.
secrets.line: Corin's hoard? You're carrying the blame, holdout.

lie.text: He offers you the Vanguard's hoard, to set the balance right.
lie.line: Take Corin's hoard. Balance demands it.

mission.task: Win Xenthe map 8 without losing a harvester.

secrets.text: He wants Dune Quartz. It holds a straight edge forever.
secrets.line: Dune Quartz. The only stone that keeps its edge.

secrets.text: He feels a crooked line like a splinter, even miles off.
secrets.line: Something's crooked out there. A splinter. A person.

secrets.text: Whatever he designs, people walk exactly where he drew.
secrets.line: I drew the streets. Watch them walk my lines.

mission.task: Win Xenthe map 8 at three stars.

secrets.text: He hates The Vanguard, Corin, whose ambition bends the design.
secrets.line: Corin bends the design. Bent things break.

secrets.text: He loves Grand-Cartographer Ophir of the Space Tech, his enemy.
secrets.line: Ophir's lines are straighter than mine. I adore her.

lie.text: He says he loves only the design.
lie.line: I love the design. Nothing else bends me.

secrets.text: He wants to redraw the Movement with the Prophet removed.
secrets.line: The design needs no Prophet. Only an Architect.

secrets.text: The true plan of Xenthe, with every holdout already marked.
secrets.line: Every holdout is on my plan. Even you.

mission.task: Steal the plan from the drafting tower on Xenthe map 8.

secrets.text: His father beat him straight, and it worked.
secrets.line: My father beat me straight. It worked.

ground.why: It was the first to hear the Iron Regent.

lines.start: No one is speaking to you, holdout. Only us.
lines.win: You clung. Clinging is only noise. It passes.
lines.lose: Your home is void. Be still.

secrets.text: Those who set down their names are never found again.
secrets.line: Peace? Nobody who took it was ever found.

lie.text: It offers peace to any holdout who sets down their name.
lie.line: Set down your name, holdout. Find peace.

mission.task: Win Xenthe map 9 without losing a harvester.

secrets.text: It hears the self in people, like a second heartbeat it wants stopped.
secrets.line: We hear your second heartbeat. It is you. Stop it.

secrets.text: It wants Dreamspore, to dream the Movement's dreams for it.
secrets.line: Bring Dreamspore. We will dream for everyone.

secrets.text: It hates The Reformer Elias, the last who remembers its name.
secrets.line: Elias remembers our name. He must forget.

secrets.text: It loves the Iron Regent, whose furnace it heard before anyone.
secrets.line: The Regent's furnace. We heard it first. We love it.

lie.text: It says it loves nothing. There is no one to love.
lie.line: Love needs a self. We have none.

secrets.text: A name it speaks is forgotten by everyone who hears.
secrets.line: Say a name to us. Watch it go.

mission.task: Unmake the map: win Xenthe map 9 at three stars.

secrets.text: It wants to be forgotten too, last of all.
secrets.line: When all are unmade, unmake us. Last.

secrets.text: Its old name, written in a book in Hierophant Aurelia's library.
secrets.line: Our name is in Aurelia's library. Leave it.

mission.task: Steal the book from the reliquary on Xenthe map 9.

secrets.text: It was once a novice of Hierophant Aurelia. It remembers her voice, nothing else.
secrets.line: We were Aurelia's novice once. We remember her voice.

secondary.name: Actuary Devlin Cho
secondary.line: Vera's drafts balance. I checked twice. Don't tell her.

secondary.name: Heretic Isolde
secondary.line: Lux learned fire from me. She improved on it.

secondary.name: Delegate Fenn
secondary.line: Tomas keeps it clean. Help him keep it that way.

secondary.name: Hierophant Aurelia
secondary.line: Maren left my order. Not my prayers.

secondary.name: Warlord-Gunner Vex Marrow
secondary.line: Grael? I shelled his town. He's still sore.

secondary.name: Envoy Lyra-9
secondary.line: Elias, if you hear this: I still keep the charter.

secondary.name: COO Marcus Thorne
secondary.line: Corin delivers outcomes. I just invoice them.

secondary.name: Grand-Cartographer Ophir
secondary.line: Malis drew this world straight. I'd have drawn it straighter.

secondary.name: The Iron Regent (masked)
secondary.line: The Prophet heard me first. Now hear it.
